profile.name: Tobias Marchetti
profile.subline: New-grad machine-learning and software roles for a May 2027 CS master's graduate · Tailored to your resume · Board re-mapped to Austin
profile.recentRole: Meta — Machine Learning Engineer Intern, Ads Ranking (Summer 2026)
profile.stack: PyTorch, CUDA, distributed training, Python, C++, two publications, Spark
profile.target: New-grad ML or software engineer · Austin, TX · remote welcome
profile.summary: You are a strong new-grad ML candidate, and the degree bars that stop information-systems applicants on this board are no obstacle for a CS master's. The board is Salt Lake-centric, so Utah employers read as relocation; Austin employers are added below.
profile.applyNow: Scale AI, Adobe's University Graduate ML Engineer and Stripe's New Grad SWE are the live doors that fit; Cloudflare's Austin data team is the local one.
profile.watchLater: Snowflake and Databricks post new-grad ML reqs in waves through the fall.
